title: Online engagement for Middle St Croix Valley to Phalen-Keller Trail now available
text:
Online engagement for Middle St Croix Valley to Phalen-Keller Trail now available
Washington County announced on June 24 that online engagement is now open for the Middle St Croix Valley to Phalen-Keller Regional Trail project. The proposed trail will be an east-west, multi-use paved route connecting the communities of Bayport, Baytown Township, West Lakeland Township, Lake Elmo, Oakdale, Landfall, Maplewood, and St. Paul.
The county held an in-person open house on June 24 from 4 to 6 p.m. at Lake Elmo City Center. There was no formal presentation during this event. Residents who were unable to attend can review materials shared at the open house and provide early input regarding potential destinations, route options, and other priorities through the project website until July 10.
The trail aims to connect users with regional destinations such as Central Greenway and Middle St Croix Valley Regional Trails, Lake Elmo Park Reserve, and Phalen and Keller Regional Parks in Ramsey County.
There will be no formal presentation or discussion during the online engagement period.
